name: Pharmacology PhD
detailsNote: Fall 2027 application confirmed. BGS common policies supplemented with degree-specific requirements; admission model omitted where not established.

applicationFee.note: No fee to apply to BGS; no waiver needed.

english.note: BGS accepts TOEFL/IELTS/DET without numerical minimum. US or approved English-instructed degree exempts after review; no separate waiver request needed. Official reports by deadline; expired TOEFL requires retake. International intake highly competitive and limited.

documents: Unofficial transcripts from all institutions plus translations
requirements.note: Bachelor degree with adequate physical/natural-science background. Three recommendations including at least one research mentor, preferably most recent. Programme TOEFL wording is narrower than current BGS accepted-tests FAQ; follow current central policy.

funding.note: Standard BGS PhD entrants receive tuition, fees, health insurance and stipend, generally 5–6 years. EffectiveFall 2026 stipend$49,000, not a Fall 2027 rate. Prior MD/VMD/DMD/PhD or other professional-degree holders must secure their own entire programme funding; international intake limited. PGG promises support to satisfactory-progress students through completion; older 2025–26 rate$42,745 is superseded by current BGS rate.
